properties.event: Response to Speaker Pelosi visit to Taiwan

properties.event: Joint Sword Exercise Day 1 — response to Tsai-McCarthy meeting

properties.description: 91 PLA aircraft tracked. 54 crossed ADIZ median line. Exercise zones covered north, south, east, and west of Taiwan.
